site.title.en: Kaixin Chun · Chinese Language Teacher & EdTech Builder
site.title.zh: 春凯欣 · 华文教师 · 教育科技开发者

site.description.en: Classroom-grounded learning tools for Chinese Language education, designed and built by a practising teacher.
site.description.zh: 由一线华文教师独立设计与开发的课堂学习工具。

hero.tagline.en: Chinese Language Teacher · EdTech Independent Developer · HOD/MTL, Pai Chai Secondary
hero.tagline.zh: 华文教师 · 教育科技独立开发者 · 百德中学 HOD/MTL

hero.intro.en: I teach Chinese Language, and I build the tools I wished my students had. No engineering background, no dev team: just classroom problems taken seriously enough to ship a solution. Everything here is in real use with real students.
hero.intro.zh: 我教华文，也亲手做出学生真正需要的工具。没有工程背景，没有开发团队：只是把课堂上的真实问题，认真做到能交付为止。这里的每一个作品，都在真实课堂中使用。

grid.subtitle.en: Smaller classroom tools, each built for one specific teaching problem.
grid.subtitle.zh: 为解决某一个具体教学问题而做的小型课堂工具。

talks.subtitle.en: Sharing the process openly, so other teachers can adapt it rather than start from zero.
talks.subtitle.zh: 公开分享开发过程，让其他老师可以直接借鉴，而不必从零开始。

approach.body1.en: Every design decision in these tools traces back to two things: Self-Determination Theory, which holds that students need autonomy, competence and relatedness to stay engaged, and Assessment for Learning, where feedback exists to move learning forward rather than to rank students.
approach.body1.zh: 这些工具的每一个设计决定，都回到两个基点：自我决定理论（SDT）：学生需要自主感、胜任感与归属感，才能持续投入；以及促进学习的评价（AfL）：反馈的意义在于推动学习，而不是给学生排名。

approach.body2.en: That is easy to say and hard to hold onto once you are actually building. The principles below are the ones I refuse to trade away for convenience.
approach.body2.zh: 这话说来容易，真正动手开发时却很难守住。以下几条，是我不愿为了方便而妥协的原则。

approach.principle1Body.en: A wrong answer costs a student nothing they have already earned. Effort accumulates in one direction only. The moment a system can take progress away, students start protecting their score instead of stretching themselves.
approach.principle1Body.zh: 答错，不会让学生失去任何已经挣得的东西。努力只朝一个方向累积。一旦系统能夺走进度，学生就会开始保护分数，而不再愿意挑战自己。

approach.principle2Body.en: Students pick which stream and which level to attempt. Being placed into a lane by the system removes autonomy; choosing a lane and finding it hard builds competence.
approach.principle2Body.zh: 学生自己决定挑战哪一个语文流、哪一个层级。被系统分配，会剥夺自主感；自己选择、并发现它有难度，才能建立胜任感。

approach.principle3Title.en: Feedback lands before the next attempt
approach.principle3Title.zh: 反馈必须赶在下一次尝试之前

approach.principle3Body.en: Feedback delivered a week later is a grade, not formative assessment. If a tool cannot respond within the same session, the pedagogy it claims is decorative.
approach.principle3Body.zh: 一周后才给的反馈，是成绩，不是形成性评价。如果一个工具无法在同一堂课内做出回应，它所标榜的教学理念只是装饰。

contact.subtitle.en: Adapting one of these for your school, or curious how it was built? Write to me: I reply to everything from teachers.
contact.subtitle.zh: 想把这些工具用在贵校，或想了解具体的开发过程？欢迎来信：来自老师的每一封信，我都会回复。

footer.built.en: Built by hand: static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript. No trackers, no analytics, no cookies.
footer.built.zh: 纯手工搭建：静态 HTML、CSS 与原生 JavaScript。无追踪、无分析工具、无 cookie。

error.dataBody.en: This page reads its content from JSON files, which browsers block when a page is opened directly from disk. Serve the folder over HTTP instead: see README.md.
